topic: Remove scale insects from a houseplant
core_question: What common household liquid, applied directly to each pest, removes scale insects from a houseplant?
answer_summary: Dip a cotton swab in rubbing alcohol and dab it directly onto each scale insect to dissolve their waxy coating and kill them, then wipe the leaves clean.
persona: dramatic and exasperated; writing in full careful sentences
